description: Returns the authenticated user's current listing capabilities: whether they can create a new listing right now (subscription plan limit), whether they have a payment/shipment method configured (both required before products.create will succeed), the max images and price their plan allows, and their remaining AI credit balance (products.create consumes 2 credits per call). Call this BEFORE asking the user for photos or calling products.create, so you can tell the user upfront if something would block listing creation, instead of finding out only after a failed attempt. Read-only, no side effects.
name: sellers.status
title: Get the authenticated seller's current listing status
